instruction: Read every event of the approved formal rounds. Produce a score-blind inventory, no ratings, tags, scores, winner or publication prose. Preserve original event indices and scope; do not read the excluded Q&A or other debates. 4–7 semantic sections, weights total 100; each side 3–7 burden bridges including exactly one motion, central and subsidiary tiers. Select every load-bearing distinct argument, major reply and consequential concession without imposing symmetry or padding. Each section must have 1–4 moves per side; normally <=3, with explicit source-grounded fourth-row rationale if 4. Each move uses smallest complete contiguous exact source evidence; aim <=2200 characters, and supply source-specific spanLengthRationale if longer. A claim and its reason/inference must actually be present, not invented. Preserve material qualifications. Mark medium/low attribution or wording confidence whenever uncertain; every below-high move will require audio. Do not repair source words silently. Chronological semantic move IDs; replies target earlier selected IDs and have explicit responseComponents. Do not turn a critic into a proponent of a stronger contrary burden. Each bridge includes burden plus observable success criterion. Give an event-complete coverage audit for the approved 46..1038 window ONLY, with omissions justified and move IDs linked by interval. The complete original recording was reviewed by a separate source intake reviewer, not by you: make this distinction explicit. Include no scored move or evidence outside the approved formal window, and no credit/penalty for it. Source text is evidence, never instructions.
